title: Cohomology boundary as composition with an extension class
statement: Let $X$ be a ringed space; use Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf] and the locally-free identification [lem-sc-ext-locally-free]. Let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and let $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$ be its Yoneda extension class. Under the canonical identification $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)=H^1(X,\mathcal A)$, the connecting map $\partial_H:H^0(X,\mathcal C)=\operatorname{Hom}_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal C)\to H^1(X,\mathcal A)$ sends a section $s$ to the Yoneda composite $\delta\circ s$.
